raw_text: Indian Navy anti-submarine warfare assets have tracked a Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy nuclear-powered attack submarine in the Bay of Bengal over a 72-hour period, The Print has learnt from defence sources. The submarine was identified as a Type 093A Shang-class SSN operating in waters east of the Andaman and Nicobar archipelago. A P-8I Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft maintained persistent surveillance while the Kamorta-class corvette INS Kadmatt provided surface ASW support. The operation demonstrates India's growing ASW capability and the increasing Chinese subsurface presence in the Indian Ocean.
clean_text: Indian Navy tracked PLAN Type 093A SSN in Bay of Bengal for 72 hours. P-8I and INS Kadmatt provided persistent ASW coverage east of Andaman Islands.
